additions.name: DayOne Imari Data Center Campus Development

status.summary: Operator announces phased campus development at Imari East Industrial Park; first operations targeted for 2030. No physical construction is asserted.

locator.precision: Published marker for the specifically named Imari East Industrial Park parent property; not a surveyed DayOne parcel, building, phase boundary or active work extent.
locator.identity_review: DayOne and Imari City identify Imari East Industrial Park. Saga prefecture guide identifies a single approximately 13.6 ha park with one approximately 7 ha industrial plateau in Matsuuracho Yamagata. Nikkan Kogyo embeds these coordinates beneath that exact park name. The map point is used only at parent-property scope.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Publisher gives no measured horizontal accuracy or datum realization. Six decimal places are retained from embedded map attributes and do not imply survey precision.

additions.distinctness_review: All 402 baseline sites and 426 projects checked; no Imari campus or Japanese DayOne match. Distinct from DayOne Fuchu and Kodaira queued projects. One physical parent property and one campus-development project.
additions.successor_review: Bounded operator and municipal review through October 14 found no later achieved construction or operating milestone. October 2 remains announcement date.

scoped_project_details.capacity_scope: Source-specific grid/powered-land figures; no selected IT load or arithmetic addition.
